snippet.title: Five Nights in Minecraft Remastered Trailer
snippet.description:
---------------------PLEASE READ DESCRIPTION!---------------------

UPDATE: Game page out! http://gamejolt.com/games/five-nights-in-minecraft-remastered/188585

This game will be a whole remake of the first game. As it because it was too buggy and... "ugly" to both many people and specially me.

FNIM 3 will still be a thing. I will work on it after FNIM:R is released.

Models were made by SlenderSonic02/AlexanderExodious and IAMOnlyMasada.
This game is made by IvanG
FNaF is made by Scott Cawthon
The trailer music is from Alien Arena
Phone Guy is MrAppleSalad
